Author: Jake Koenig
Summary: I'm slowly coming to realize that a big reason I enjoy wfh so much is that the baseline IQ feels at least half a standard deviation higher in my basement. It's this intangible aspect to every conversation across a wide range of personalities, like a brain fog was lifted.
